## Summary

I exposed the two existing routes as MCP tools rather than writing new features. In `routes/web.ts`, `posts.search` and `posts.store` carry `agent` metadata with the tool names `posts_search` and `posts_store`, and `posts.store` also has a `resource` hint. They run through the site's existing validation, `auth` middleware and `PostPolicy`. I installed `@guren/plugin-mcp` (`package.json`, `bun.lock`) and registered it in `src/app.ts` with `EventServiceProvider`, which serves `/mcp`. Also in `src/app.ts`, `app.auth.useTokens(new DatabaseApiTokenStore(apiTokens), { provider: 'users' })` configures the bearer token store, backed by a new `api_tokens` table in `db/schema.ts` with migration `db/migrations/20260929192543_create_api_tokens/`. `PostController.store` returns the created post as JSON to JSON callers and keeps the redirect for the form. I added `tests/Mcp.test.ts`, covering the 401 without a credential, the tool listing and read-only flags, token scopes, search parity with `QUERY /posts/search`, authorship with `authorId` ignored, the 422 case, the guest cases and the form redirect. I also regenerated `.guren/agents.gen.ts` and `.guren/api-client.gen.ts`, and recorded the decision in `docs/adr/0002-serve-post-search-and-creation-to-assistants-over-mcp.md`.
